prompt: Name one of the ten largest US fast-food chains by systemwide sales.
label: Easy Opener
asOf: By US systemwide sales in 2025, per QSR Magazine.

answers.name: McDonald's
answers.fact: $55 billion in US sales in 2025, more than the next two combined.

answers.name: Starbucks
answers.fact: Second by sales, and second only to Subway for US locations, with nearly 17,000.

answers.name: Subway
answers.fact: Tenth by sales but easily first by locations - 18,773 of them.

answers.name: Burger King
answers.fact: Eighth, after four straight years of outgrowing the rest of the burger category.

answers.name: Taco Bell
answers.fact: Fourth, and the fastest riser among the legacy chains.

answers.name: Wendy's
answers.fact: Sixth. Founded in Columbus in 1969 and named for the founder's daughter.

answers.name: Chick-fil-A
answers.fact: Third by sales on only 3,287 restaurants - by far the highest average per store.

answers.name: Domino's
answers.fact: Ninth. The company has said it sells delivery more than it sells pizza.

answers.name: Dunkin'
answers.fact: Fifth, with 9,999 locations - one short of a round number.

answers.name: Chipotle
answers.fact: Seventh, and the only one of the ten that owns every one of its US restaurants.

distractors.name: Pizza Hut
distractors.note: A giant, but outside the top ten by US sales.

distractors.name: KFC
distractors.note: Outside the ten in the US, though enormous worldwide.

distractors.name: Popeyes
distractors.note: Growing fast, still outside the ten.

distractors.name: Raising Cane's
distractors.note: Second-highest sales per restaurant in the country, but not top ten overall.

distractors.name: In-N-Out
distractors.note: Third-highest sales per restaurant, on only 431 locations.
